findings.title: Post-reopen state, history and accounting are asserted only through the owner's own fail-closed checks
findings.evidence: The plan's GREEN acceptance requires the reopened room to prove exact state, semantic digest, ACL/writer authority, anchor, history root/size, archive root, snapshot/manifest, journal, operation accounting and issuance continuity. The focused test and focused-evidence.json record only handle epoch 2, lifecycle active, recovery active-new, trust epoch 2, coldIssued authorSequence 4 accepted and coldPublished published; every remaining item rests on reopenCreatorSuccessorAdoption's internal verification at packages/node/src/creator-adoption.ts:1098-1153 rather than an independent oracle.
findings.required_action: Non-blocking. Owner D.110c-0c/D.110c-d: serialize an independently derived post-reopen state digest, history root/size and operation accounting in the focused evidence before the long-horizon gate. No change required for this checkpoint.

findings.title: Filtered issuance-store skip counters accumulate per store instance rather than per outbox scan
findings.evidence: `skipped` and `skippedGenesis` are declared in the creatorFilteredIssuanceStore closure, outside readOutboxPage, so they accumulate over the whole lifetime of the wrapper. After 0b1 that wrapper is the active plane's long-lived issuance store for every epoch>=1 cold reopen (line 7413), whereas previously the non-handoff path used the unfiltered store. Exceeding maxEpochVertices (8192) stops the filtering and returns the unauthenticatable row, which the reader then rejects. Practically bounded because publishPending advances publicationCursor past the low-sequence genesis rows and the rebase snapshot is cached, and the outcome is fail-closed, not a bypass.
findings.required_action: Non-blocking. Owner D.110c-0c/D.110c-d bounded-census gate: scope both counters per readOutboxPage invocation (or reset them per call) and add a census assertion. No behavioural change is required for the frozen two-transition contract.

findings.title: Pending epoch-0 outbox rows become unpublishable from an epoch>=2 plane and break rebase reads
findings.evidence: The authenticated pinned-genesis filter is attached to the successor plane's long-lived issuance store, so readOutboxPage never surfaces an epoch-0 row again; an epoch-0 row still in `pending` would therefore never be published after an epoch-2 cold reopen. readRebaseOutbox (line 6016) instead selects displacedSource.issuanceStore, which is the unfiltered store, so the same row makes readRebaseOutbox return record-rejected. Both are fail-closed and require a genuinely creator-signed, issued-row-matching row, so there is no forgery or state-divergence path.
findings.required_action: Non-blocking. Owner D.110c-0c: state this durability consequence explicitly alongside the already-recorded arbitrary-intermediate-issuance deferral, and close it with the general intermediate-epoch issuance recovery work before the >=100-transition gate.
